guideUpdate.title: Open API Request Audit and return to the V4 launcher
steps: From the V4 launcher, select Open API request audit on the API Request Audit card.
Use the API Request Audit dashboard to view request metrics, the Requests and errors over time chart, and Request explorer.
Use the browser Back control to return to the V4 launcher and display its module cards again.
screenshotCaptions: The V4 launcher shows the API Request Audit card with its active open control.
The API Request Audit dashboard shows identifiable module content, including request metrics and the Requests and errors over time chart.
The browser Back control has returned to the V4 launcher, where the module cards are visible again.
